about.text: Lactoid is a trade name for casein-formaldehyde plastic, of the Galalith kind.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

how.text: Lactoid is listed with Erinoid and Galalith as a trade name of casein-formaldehyde; the process is the galalith one, hardening in formaldehyde.
